en: A black‑and‑white vintage photograph of a dramatic rocky mountain massif with patches of snow on its steep slopes. A tall conifer tree stands on the right foreground, while the base of the mountain shows sparse vegetation and remnants of snowfields. The image is framed by a white border with scalloped edges, typical of mid‑20th‑century postcards. No printed caption or visible handwriting appears on the front.
